name: cloud-nav
description: Diego's Cloud Nav — dedicated maps/navigation/tracker Android app. Single APK, gradle multi-module (app/ Google-Maps-style shell + libs/{core,maps}). MapLibre Native renderer, GPS tracker + Stop detection, multi-stop routing, driving navigation view, place-category browsing, and a timeline of visited places. Lifted out of Cloud SuperApp's libs:maps into its own focused app. Build via Nix devShell, one APK out.

android._doc_abi_filters: arm64-v8a only — MapLibre Native ships ~15-18MB of .so per ABI. Every Samsung Galaxy from S8 + every modern Pixel is arm64. Add armeabi-v7a/x86_64 here for 32-bit/emulator support; no Kotlin/gradle edits needed.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps (Cloud-Comms hub+forks, Cloud-Nav, Cloud-IDE, Cloud-SuperApp). The SAME key signs every app so cross-app signature-IPC + the in-app fleet updater never hit a signature mismatch. KEY LOCATION (raw credential + sops passwords live ONLY in the vault repo): A0_keys/providers/android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A0_keys/providers/android/signing.secrets.yaml. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR (default ~/git/cloud-vault) + sops-decrypts the passwords, exporting ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE/ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD which the gradle signingConfig reads. CI does the same via a vault checkout + the SOPS_AGE_KEY secret. THERE IS NO FALLBACK: if the key is unavailable the build FAILS LOUD telling you to use the one shared key — it never generates or substitutes a random/legacy key.

diagnostics._doc: On-device DevControlServer diagnostics → cloud sink + local download. Baked into BuildConfig.LOG_SINK_URL / LOG_SINK_STREAM by app/build.gradle. log_sink_url is our OpenObserve (the Loki-equivalent log store on oci-apps) ingest, reached via the PUBLIC first-party analytics collector so NO credential is embedded in the public APK (the collector relays to openobserve server-side). '{stream}' in the url is replaced with log_sink_stream at runtime. EMPTY url = cloud push disabled (the 'Download logs' action still works fully); set it to the confirmed collector ingest path to enable one-tap 'Send logs to cloud'. Data-driven: change here, every app rebuild picks it up — never hardcode in Kotlin.

emulator._doc: build.sh emulator boots an arm64 AVD for full-fidelity testing of the arm64-v8a APK. ABI/API must match flake.nix. avd_name created idempotently from system_image.

toolchain._doc: Pinned for reproducibility — all derived in flake.nix. Bump here, rebuild devShell.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph. settings.gradle iterates this list. Adding a new feature module = one entry here + mkdir + minimal build.gradle.

ui._doc_nav_tabs: Bottom navigation tabs. Order = display order. id maps to a Fragment in MainActivity.fragmentForTab(); icon maps to R.drawable.ic_nav_<icon>.
ui._doc_search_islands: Small round 'island' shortcut chips rendered in a row beneath the top search bar (Google-Maps style). action is parsed by the active fragment.
ui._doc_places_categories: Place categories for the Places tab islands. query is the Overpass POI tag filter; emoji is the chip glyph (Google-Maps-style, data-driven — no per-category drawables).
ui._doc_poi_detail_fields: Rows shown in the Places POI detail sheet (tap a pin). Iterated in order; each pulls its OSM [tag] from the hit's raw tags — absent tags are skipped. kind: text (plain) | url (opens browser) | phone (dials) | email. First non-blank of tag|alt tags wins. name/type/distance are rendered separately at the top; remaining un-listed tags collapse under 'More'. Data-driven — add a row here, no Kotlin change.
ui._doc_map_styles: Basemaps. Every raster style declares `vector_equivalent` — the real vector/hybrid style MapsBasemapPrefs.resolve() substitutes when the family preference (or an explicit pin) says 'vector': light→vector_light, dark→vector_dark, satellite→satellite_hybrid (satellite is photographic imagery, not vector geometry, so its 'vector' form is a hybrid: the raster imagery with an English roads+labels vector overlay composited on top, built by VectorStyleLoader.buildHybrid — fill/background/water polygon layers from the overlay source are dropped, only line + name-bearing symbol layers survive, recolored white-on-black-halo for legibility over arbitrary imagery). Each vector/hybrid entry declares `raster_fallback` — if its network fetch fails at runtime, MapsMapFragment falls back to that raster key automatically (toasted, never a blank map). `default_family` (vector|raster) is Configs > APIs 'Basemap' menu's default resolution when no style is explicitly pinned there; picking a concrete entry from that menu pins it everywhere, overriding the family default. `order` = every entry, in the cycle the in-map Map-switcher FAB (under locate-me) steps through AND the full list shown in the Configs menu. vector_light/vector_dark are real vector-tile GL styles (vector_style_url, OpenFreeMap 'positron'/'dark') localized at runtime to prefer label_field_pref (falls back to name:latin, then name) — city/country/street labels render in English everywhere instead of each place's local script. Uses OpenFreeMap (openfreemap.org) — free, no API key, no rate limit.

map_styles._doc_default_style: When set, this style is the resolved default for EVERY screen (routes/nav/places/timeline) — overriding each screen's own raw pick — unless the user has explicitly pinned another in Configs > Basemap. Must be a key in `order`.
map_styles._doc_default_3d: First-run value for the manual 3D-buildings tilt (MapsBasemapPrefs.is3d) — true opens every map tilted with 3D buildings on. User can still toggle it off (persisted).

satellite_hybrid.label: Satellite (labels)
satellite_hybrid.attribution: © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics · © OpenFreeMap, © OpenMapTiles

map_styles._doc_hillshade: Real-elevation hillshade added to every vector style by VectorStyleLoader (NOT a selectable basemap — not in `order`). Terrarium-encoded raster-DEM from AWS's keyless Terrain Tiles open dataset; MapLibre Native renders a hillshade layer (accurate mountain relief, replacing the flat painted ne2_shaded image). NOTE: this is 2D shading — true 3D tilted terrain is unsupported by MapLibre Native (maplibre-native#252, unfunded).
map_styles._doc_nature: Vivid-green nature layer added to every vector style by VectorStyleLoader.injectNature (NOT a selectable basemap — not in `order`). OpenMapTiles' own landcover/landuse fills render wood/grass/park/forest/meadow/grassland in whatever muted tone the upstream style picked (near-white on positron, near-black on dark/liberty), so nature barely reads against the basemap. Synthesizes ONE additional fill layer from the same vector source, filtered to `classes` via a match expression, painted `green_color` at `opacity`. `minzoom` keeps it off at world-scale zooms where it would just be noise.

ui._doc_search_cache: On-device cache for forward-search + POI lookups (NOT reverse-geocode, which never expires). New bars/shops appear slowly and the public Nominatim/Overpass endpoints are fair-use, so results for the same query/area are reused for ttl_days. Stored in the maps.db places_cache table keyed fwd:/poi:. Consumed by MapsProviderClient (baked UI_SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_DAYS).
ui._doc_search_choices: How many forward-search candidates the search bar offers the user to pick from (Routes/Navigation show a chooser instead of auto-picking the first hit).
ui._doc_search_scopes: Radius-scope islands shown when the Places search bar is focused. radius_km bounds the forward search around the user (0 = worldwide). default_search_scope = the one pre-selected.
ui._doc_routing: Route geometry + per-mode distance/time. valhalla_public = FOSSGIS Valhalla (free, no key, fair-use) — real road routes for car/walk/bike/bus. boat/flight/swim have no router → great-circle estimate. Consumed by MapsRouting (baked UI_ROUTING_ENDPOINT).
ui._doc_travel_modes: Route mode switcher (Routes tab) + the all-modes stats panel. engine=valhalla → real route via `costing`; engine=geodesic → straight-line distance ÷ avg_speed_kmh estimate. estimated=true flags approximations (bus = road approximation, not transit timetables). default_travel_mode = the one selected on open.
ui._doc_cockpit_modes: Navigation-tab vehicle cockpit switcher. Distinct from travel_modes (routing costing) — this drives the live instrument PANEL + map camera on the Navigation tab. Per mode: accent (hex), style (map_styles key), zoom/tilt/follow_bearing (camera), speed_unit (kmh|kn|mph), alt_unit (m|ft), gauges (ordered instrument ids rendered left→right). Gauge ids: speed, heading (compass rose), attitude (artificial horizon), altitude (tape), vspeed, grade, avg, dist, eta, position, track. Add a mode = one entry here (data-driven; no Kotlin change).
ui._doc_demo_stops: Tester seed (Configs > Tracker > Load demo data): FULL daily coverage 1987-01-01..1992-12-31 (2192 days), FIXED dates so it never collides with real data. 228 REAL cities / 38 countries from front/b-MyData/mymaps-mytrips/public/travel-data.json (one base point each). place_variations (shared, expanded at parse time by MapsDemo) give every city 3 DISTINCT places → every seeded day has 3 stops (>=2), so Explored PLACES (grouped from ALL stops) shows ~3x the CITY pins. Kept COMPACT (variations shared, not duplicated 228x) so the base64 fits the 64KB Java string constant limit. computeDailyLocations still picks one place/day → Daily/CITY stay clean.

profile_default._doc_repos: Repo URLs + the consolidated cloud-data config reference, surfaced read-only in Configs/About → Profile. Data-driven (no Kotlin hardcoding) — baked via UI_PROFILE_REPOS_B64 / UI_CONSOLIDATED_CONFIG.
profile_default.consolidated_config: cloud/2_configs/dist/_cloud-data-consolidated.json → baked into the app as data/mesh.json (BuildConfig.MESH_JSON_B64), the full wg-mesh/v1 node + peer + transport snapshot

permissions._doc_roles: Single-holder RoleManager roles surfaced as Special-access rows on Configs/About → Permissions. These are NOT held by the SuperApp (it's a launcher with no dialer / call-screening service) — the holder is the Cloud-Comms phone fork (or Fossify Phone in the interim). The SuperApp cannot grant another app a role programmatically (createRequestRoleIntent only ever targets the calling app), so each row (a) reads the LIVE holder via RoleManager.getRoleHolders / TelecomManager.getDefaultDialerPackage and shows ✓ when the holder is one of `expected_holders`, and (b) the 'Set Default Apps' button deep-links to Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_DEFAULT_APPS_SETTINGS so the user picks Cloud-Comms there. `role` is the literal android.app.role.* constant passed straight to RoleManager. When our own fork ships, add its package to the relevant expected_holders[] — zero code change.

release._doc: Data-driven publish targets. build.sh oras-push + gh-release read this block; the GHA workflow (1_cicd/src/cicd/ship-cloud-nav.yml) invokes those engine commands. release.auto_update + variants[].update_tag feed libs:updater (the in-app self-updater on Configs → Update).
release._doc_variants: Per-ABI build variants — CI runs one matrix job per variant. arm64 is the DEFAULT (engine behaves as before when CLOUDNAV_VARIANT is unset). x86_64 is the Waydroid / desktop-emulator artifact, published to the SAME rolling 'latest' GH release under a distinct filename and to GHCR under tag suffix -x86_64. Engine reads each variant's abis (→ CLOUDNAV_ABIS), artifact_debug, gh_asset, ghcr_tag_suffix. Add an ABI = append a variant + the matrix entry.

auto_update._doc: In-app updater config — read at gradle eval time into libs:updater BuildConfig, used at runtime by the Update tab in Configs. Same registry/namespace/image as release.ghcr. ABI-aware: arm64 pulls 'latest', x86_64 pulls 'latest-x86_64' (release.variants[].update_tag).
auto_update._doc_install: Declared default for the runtime Auto-update toggle (Configs/About → Permissions). 'silent' → USER_ACTION_NOT_REQUIRED (no install prompt) once 'Install unknown apps' is granted; falls back to a prompt without it. 'prompt' → always USER_ACTION_REQUIRED.

ghcr._doc: ORAS push as an OCI artifact (APK blob, not a container). one :latest + per-sha + per-version tags; per-variant suffix -x86_64 for the x86 artifact.

gh_release._doc: Rolling GH release named 'latest' (shared across the ea_cloud-* apps; each contributes distinctly-named APK assets), overwritten every main push so /releases/latest/download/Cloud-Nav.apk stays stable.
